questions.question: Which learner, prior-knowledge, terminology, accessibility, and language contract applies?
questions.answer: Maintainers and training leads are primary, apprentices are secondary; basic Git, Markdown, and repository knowledge is assumed, but Spec Kit and security abbreviations are not. Terms are explained on first use. User-facing results are text-first, WCAG-2.2-AA-capable, CEFR-B2, and complete in German first and English second.
questions.evidence: Explicit current user answer approving the complete IR002 contract.

questions.question: Which status-dependent evidence-matrix field contract applies?
questions.answer: Every row has ID, normative source, status, and rationale; Applicable, AlreadySatisfied, N/A, Open, and FollowUp use the separately stated required fields consistently across requirements, expected artifacts, acceptance, and prompts.
